messages:
maya (runtime): FYI: dedicated canary for reserved pool A is showing a p95 latency regression after merge #4123. customer SLA risk. :worried:

maya (runtime): symptoms: 2-5x p95 on heavy-seq workloads, baseline throughput unchanged, increased tail queueing. spotting across 3 nodes in the pool.

derek (perf): link to PR? any kernel-selection changes in that merge?

maya (runtime): PR 4123 - https://git.redwood/infra/merge/4123 - main change was kernel-hinting heuristics (autokernel: prefer-fused for short seqs) + bump kv-prefetch window default from 8->16.

jen (oncall): deploy-bot shows the canary rolled at 2034567800, CI perf job 7623 failed earlier with +40% p95 on the same test. Did we skip rollback? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout started by maya at 2034567800. commit: abcdef123.

maya (runtime): CI perf failure link: https://ci.redwood/perf/7623 - job shows tail latencies spike right after autokernel heuristic jobs started.

oliver (sre): can we reproduce locally with dedicated-sim? I can spin a reserved pool replicate.

qa-sim-bot: repro steps: 
- run: ./tools/dedicated-sim --pool reserved-A --workload heavyseq --concurrency 48 --seq-dist 'long:40%'
- config override: kernel.hint=autokernel-prefer-fused, kv.prefetch_window=16

qa-sim-bot: sample log snippet from reproduction:

[2026-03-18T14:56:03Z] request_id=xyz queue_ms=72 start_kernel=select_fused
[2026-03-18T14:56:03Z] request_id=xyz execute_ms=420 p95_ms=380
[2026-03-18T14:56:03Z] request_id=abc queue_ms=12 start_kernel=select_merge
[2026-03-18T14:56:03Z] request_id=abc execute_ms=90 p95_ms=85

maya (runtime): repro matches. looks like fused path amplification for mixed seqs, plus kv-prefetch larger window is causing prefetch IO blocking in corner case with high concurrency.

derek (perf): ran perf profile on canary node (flame graph link): https://perf.redwood/graphs/2034567832 - hot functions: kv::populate_prefetch, fused_attention_forward, thread-pool-queue-wait. suggests prefetch holds thread-pool workers longer, increasing queue.

derek (perf): quick excerpt:
```
# stack sample percentages
20% kv::populate_prefetch
18% fused_attention_forward
12% thread::worker_wait
```

oliver (sre): if prefetch holds a worker while waiting on IO/lock, it reduces parallelism for kernels which need the worker to schedule, causing tail.

jen (oncall): we need immediate mitigation. options: revert PR 4123, revert kv-prefetch bump only, or hotpatch runtime to cap prefetch concurrency for reserved pools. any quick wins?

maya (runtime): low-risk quick win: revert kv.prefetch_window back to 8 in canary config only (per-pool override). will try that now.

maya (runtime): applied override to reserved-A canary at 2034567860. monitoring.

deploy-bot: config change applied (canary override) by maya at 2034567861.

qa-sim-bot: after override repro (same sim) p95 back to baseline in local replicate: 90ms -> 95ms.

jen (oncall): nice. hold the main rollout until root cause fixed. request: put rollout on hold and open a rollback/revert decision doc.

maya (runtime): putting rollout on hold now. added label "rollout-hold" to the release.

derek (perf): we should still bisect kernel-hint heuristic separately. I can run a gated CI job to test autokernel prefer-fused vs prefer-merge across seq mixes.

maya (runtime): agreed. Derek please run CI matrix with prefetch window both 8 and 16, and kernel hint toggles. include perf job and dedicated-sim baseline.

derek (perf): started perf-bisect matrix job 7630. will report results in ~40m.

oliver (sre): action items:
- maya: keep canary override pinned, update customer status if SLA-facing (assigned)
- derek: perf matrix + bisect (assigned)
- jen: prepare rollback doc & coordinate with eng-ops if revert needed (assigned)
- maya+oliver: monitor reserved pools for 2h, escalate if p95 > baseline *2

maya (runtime): adding short postmortem stub to the release notes so we don't forget details.

jen (oncall): thanks team. great reaction time. once bisect finishes we'll decide revert vs targeted patch. :thumbsup:

derek (perf): perf-bisect job 7630: early results show kernel-hint causes regressions only when prefetch_window >=12 and heavy long-seq fraction >30%. will post full table when complete.

maya (runtime): copying customers impacted to privacy channel and prepping a short outbound note.

oliver (sre): leaving this thread open until rollback decision finalized and canary stable for 2h.

maya (runtime): noted. I'll post final status when canary hits 2h stable or we revert.
